dataSource.fetchedBy: research agent, verified against the official source
dataSource.notes:
SOURCE: Panera's own "Panera Bread® Nutrition Guide", Effective 6/17/2026, Edition 1 (c6-26-nutrition-guide.pdf), linked from panerabread.com/en-us/menu/nutritious-eating/allergen-and-nutrition-information.html. NOTE the lead URL in the task (nutrition-and-allergens.html) is a 404 — the live nav points to the allergen-and-nutrition-information.html path above, which is where I got the current PDF link.

ACCESS: panerabread.com is behind Akamai bot protection; plain fetches returned 403. The PDF was retrieved with a full browser header set including a same-origin Referer. Everything below comes from that official PDF — no aggregator was used.

EXTRACTION + VERIFICATION: The PDF has 36 pages of tables with columns Serving Size / Calories / Calories-from-Fat / Fat / Sat Fat / Trans / Cholesterol / Sodium / Carbs / Fiber / Sugars / Protein. I parsed all 576 data rows and ran a checksum on every one: calories-from-fat vs fat x 9. All 576 rows passed, which confirms no column drift or misalignment in the numbers I used. I then cross-checked calories against Panera's live menu pages (soups, salads, sandwiches, market bowls, sides): every soup, market bowl, side, and 15 of 18 sandwiches matched the PDF exactly.

FOUR KNOWN DISCREPANCIES (PDF vs live site, all 10 kcal, site lower). I used the PDF because it is the only source publishing full macros; the site publishes calories only: Bacon Turkey Bravo whole PDF 860 / site 850; Turkey & Cheddar whole PDF 840 / site 830; Fuji Apple Chicken Salad whole PDF 710 / site 700; Fuji Apple Chicken Salad Stuffer PDF 700 / site 690. Likely a recipe tweak landing on the site ahead of the PDF. Treat those four as +/-10 kcal.

ONE PDF GAP RESOLVED BY COLUMN POSITION: the Kettle Cooked Potato Chips row has a blank Fiber cell, so it carries only 10 of 11 values. I measured character offsets against known-complete rows to confirm the blank is Fiber and that carbs=17, sugars=<1, protein=2. Fiber is simply not published for that item; the four macros I report are the stated ones.

PORTIONS: All macros are per one of the stated serving description, exactly as the guide states it (1 Sandwich, 1 Salad, 1 Bowl, 1 Cup, 1 1/2 Cups, 1 dressing cup, 2 oz slice, etc.). Nothing was reverse-engineered or divided — every number is printed in the guide.

CATEGORY DESIGN: "mains" holds only whole sandwiches, whole salads, and Market Bowls — every one of which Panera separately publishes a matching half portion, so the split-base rule maps cleanly onto Panera's You Pick Two. Panera's published halves are rounded independently and can differ from exactly half the whole by up to ~10 kcal (e.g. Fuji Apple whole 710, published half 350). "entrees" holds items with no published half: Soups & Mac in all three published sizes, Salad Stuffers, and the two Asiago Bagel Stacks — these are deliberately kept out of "mains" so the split rule never invents a half portion Panera does not publish. Bread bowls and Salad Stuffers are modeled as whole items rather than presets because their published totals do NOT equal soup + bread bowl or half-salad + roll (Panera uses less soup and hollows the loaf; e.g. Broccoli Cheddar bowl 420 + Sourdough Soup Bowl 650 = 1070 but the published bread bowl is 930).
